reason: Concurrent export formatting coincided with high memory compression; lower scheduling priority and one active exporter protect the live app and numerical worker.
resume_requirement: The active cleaning exporter may be followed automatically by interface in the original driver. After interface completes, resume corrected-support, then provision. Do not finish or leave the workers paused. No original source, numerical inputs or recorded trace is changed.
scope: Operational resource scheduling of derived archive formatting only. Timing of export jobs includes these pauses; it is not a calibrated throughput estimate.

follow_up.scope: One host sample after reducing active exporters; not a controlled performance experiment or a guarantee of future latency.

measurement: Difference between vm_stat cumulative page counters over two seconds; host page size 16384 bytes. Compression counts are churn, not resident memory.
